scope: AL-S05 stores source only; no installed/live provider acceptance

r1_findings.finding: StoreCommand.action max length did not fit revoke_credential.
r1_findings.resolution_reviewed: Model and initial migration now use max_length=24; PostgreSQL qualification adds Performance-only revocation and verifies the active Seller remains and Performance ciphertext is erased.

r1_findings.finding: Stored idempotency digest was unkeyed SHA-256 over a request containing credentials.
r1_findings.resolution_reviewed: Fingerprint now uses Django salted_hmac with dedicated domain salt and an environment/product/tenant/customer/command envelope. Added test rejects plaintext SHA-256 equality and cross-tenant fingerprint equality.

additional_review: Validation claim remains durable before IPC; no DB transaction spans IPC; finalization compares current customer security revision, store revision/status, and credential revision status.
check_started audit is now recorded in the same transaction as the RUNNING command claim.
Foreign-store browser case now reauthenticates the second test customer and asserts a valid distinct tenant before requiring exact 404 isolation response.
remaining_gates: CI rerun for this exact source candidate was pending during review.
RT-CHECK remains proposed/client-only; no runtime-side socket/provider implementation is included or accepted.
Full S05 acceptance still requires separately authorized real Ozon, WB, and Performance provider checks.
review_limits: Read-only source inspection; reviewer ran no tests and performed no host actions.
No secrets or provider credentials were read or included.
